alt: AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women in a pale stone lounge overlooking the Adriatic. A braided woman and a blonde woman share a side embrace while a seated woman reaches toward them and the fourth leans in for a temple greeting. Two wear Croatian-flag minis, alongside a pearl one-shoulder dress with a cobalt fold and a cobalt mini with pearl piping. Turquoise ankle boots, pearl sandals, copper knee-high boots and cobalt platforms vary across the group. IA, wave and star arm tattoos are visible.
